decisions.reason: The necessary same-message MODIFY already records that the É accent must be the literal terminal section of the approved Hero V right arm and not an independent redraw.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the exact shared gesture across the Hero V, second V, and É accent, including the accent's literal derivation.
The client reaffirms the previously selected Option 2 Hero V rather than changing its required geometry; the candidate state already identifies Option 2 as the selected reference.
The source decision concerns the V-system gesture and É accent, not the deferred construction of the unaccented E and L letterforms.
Requiring the closing v to use the Hero V's exact gesture does not change its existing smaller, subordinate visual prominence.
The geometric relationship among the V forms and É accent does not alter the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source decision does not change the deferred requirement for cohesive full-wordmark kerning.
The design change does not modify the independent obligation to include rationale with review rounds.
The source decision has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
